text:
Casey: Post-launch quick sync — overall stable but small regressions + a few paying-customer asks. Need a decision for the next 2 weeks: focused patch wave (reliability) or pull in 1-2 enhancements that could drive expansion?
Marta: Let's be pragmatic. Can we quantify customer impact vs dev effort quickly?
Devon: Crash uptick ~0.5-0.8% last day (baseline ~0.1). Embeddings 95th latency +200ms on a subset. Batcher A/B shows small regressions on long-seq workloads.
Sam: Support has 6 escalations from enterprise customers citing embedding inconsistencies. Also two customers asked for cache TTL controls — recurring but lower immediacy.
Ajay: My vote is reliability-first but allow a fast-track for any enhancement that has clear revenue unblock.
Rania: Agree. Recommend triage matrix: impact (customer count + severity) x dev-days x risk. Anything <=2 dev-days + low risk => consider for patch.
Casey: Proposed plan: 1) Triage + low-risk quick fixes in hotpatch 2) Ship guardrail/feature-flag for cache desync if quick 3) Batch latency tweaks if A/B confirms small perf wins 4) Put larger UX work into a scoped mini-epic next sprint.
Marta: I'll get dev estimates and surface risk flags by EOD.
Devon: Quick estimates: KV cache desync full fix 3-5d, guardrail flag ~0.5d (reduces incidents ~60%). Batcher tuning ~1-2d if we don't revert A/B. TTL toggle backend ~2d + docs; console UI >8d.
Sam: Support playbook draft will include workaround, how to enable flag, and escalation contacts.
Casey: Owners: Devon -> guardrail + batcher tuning; Sam -> support playbook + TTL risk assessment; Rania -> customer impact mapping (which customers affected); Marta -> schedule + QA slot; Casey -> release comms + changelog.
Devon: Starting branch. Test checklist going into PR:
```
- unit tests around KV apply/sync
- microbenchmark for batcher long sequences
- canary to 10% (monitor errors/latency for 60m)
```
Marta: Proposed patch window Thu 09:30-11:30 PT. planning-bot: Please confirm with :thumbsup:.
Casey: :thumbsup: Thu works. Can we also reserve Fri morning as fallback?
Devon: Confirmed. I'll aim for Thu and keep Fri free as rollback window.
Ajay: I'll draft the short customer-facing note and internal changelog blurb. Will share link here.
Sam: Adding templated replies for support and marking high-touch accounts.
Rania: I'll tag the impacted enterprise customers and coordinate AM touchpoints post-deploy.
Casey: Final patch checklist before merge: tests green, security scan green, canary 10% for 1h with no regression, support playbook ready, customer note + changelog. If any fail gate -> pause and triage.
planning-bot: ACTION: owners assigned: Devon=guardrail+batcher; Sam=TTL+support; Rania=customer-map; Marta=schedule+QA; Casey=comms. Deadline: 72h to initial canary.
Casey: Thanks team — small, focused, and observable. We'll reconvene after canary and then align which enhancement(s) to pull into the mini-epic for the next sprint.
